_comment: Recipe knowledge ladder (systems/recipe_knowledge.gd, .scratch/recipe-acquisition/spec.md) -- provisional numbers, tagged for balance. rungs = the ladder in order (base, then data/lab.json's hint rungs); rungCeilings = the highest rank a recipe can reach with every rung up to and including that one owned. sellers: a recipe belongs to the first seller whose ores list holds every one of its ingredient ores, else to defaultSeller. sourceAliases maps a grant source id onto a seller id (the Guild faction draws on Wren's recipes). collision = the fallback when a sourced grant would teach nothing new and the source has no other recipe left to teach: crafting xp, relation bump with the source, and the acknowledgement line keyed by source id, else its alias, else default. masterSources.<recipeKey> = { source: npc/faction id or null, pointer: text or null }; a null pointer reads as unknownPointer. Buying: price = consumablePrices × priceMultipliers[rung] (priceOverrides.<recipe>.<rung> replaces it), less a goodwill discount of up to maxDiscount, linear from discount.zeroAt to discount.fullAt on the shop's contact relation or key-member standing. shops.<seller> = name, unlockFlag (state.flags), gate per hint rung (contactRelation: contact relation at or above; factionTier: Perks tier at or above) plus gate.text, the recipe book's lock reason (% the required relation or tier label), discount source. ladder = the recipe book's rung ladder strings: heading, row % [rung label, ceiling, note], states (owned rung note), ceiling % rank, soldBy % shop name, join % [soldBy, gate.text] while the gate is unmet. bankLabel % [recipe name, rung label, shop name]. insight = the roll after each finished manual run (not cracked, abandoned or batch): chance base + perSkill x crafting skill reveals one unknown hidden inserted step of the lowest unowned rung that has one, at insight specificity; step % [apparatus name, position in the known procedure] names it, result % step is the run result line, ladder.insight % steps is added to a locked rung's note. buyRefusals = the reason buy() gives per refusal (order % previous rung label). PROSE-REVIEW: insight.step, insight.result, ladder.insight, collision.lines, unknownPointer, rungLabels, buyRefusals, ladder, shops.*.gate.text.

buyRefusals.master: Not for sale. Some things you have to earn.

lines.default: Nothing you didn't already know. You practise it anyway, and it shows.
lines.james: "You know this one." James watches you work it through regardless. "Then do it properly."
lines.wren: Wren checks her ledger. "Already on your file. I'll note the diligence instead."
